_comment: Machine-readable field manifest for the fields test_pipeline.js / validate_metrics.js actually reference. Used by scripts/healthcheck.js to verify a target library's schema before running any extraction, so a missing/renamed field fails fast with a clear message instead of a raw SQL error mid-pipeline or a silent NULL/0 baked into the report. 'type':'key' fields only need to exist; 'type':'metric' fields should additionally have a lastVerifiedNonConstant entry once someone has empirically confirmed (against real data, not just column existence) that the field actually carries varying values — existence alone does not mean the field is meaningful (see QAPMJOBL.JBPAGF in knownDeadFields, which exists with the right name/type but is always 0).

_schemaVerifiedEnvironments.result: All 26 fields below identical (name/type/length) across all four environments. Only difference found: QAPMISUM has 153 columns on 7.4/7.5 vs 152 on 7.3 (confirmed release-driven: both 7.3 hosts show 152, both 7.4/7.5 hosts show 153; the extra column is not one this manifest uses). Re-run this diff whenever a new OS release/host is added — matching 4 times does not guarantee a 5th will.

QAPMISUM.purpose: 15-minute interval system summary: transaction count/response time, page faults

INTSEC.purpose: elapsed seconds in interval (denominator for Usr)

QAPMSYSTEM.purpose: LPAR CPU capacity per interval, joined to QAPMISUM for CPU%

QAPMJOBL.purpose: per-job/thread per-interval stats: Top-N job ranking and Interactive CPU split

JBTYPE.purpose: job type (I/B/V/S/M/W/A/X, etc.) — used to isolate Interactive (JBTYPE='I')

JBCPU.purpose: thread unscaled CPU ms — summed for Top-CPU ranking and Interactive CPU split

JBTFLT.purpose: total page faults per job/interval — used for Top-Fault ranking (NOT the same semantics as QAPMISUM.JBTFLT)

JBADBR.purpose: asynchronous database reads (part of TOTAL_IO, MIMIX diagnosis)

QAPMDISK.purpose: per-disk-ARM per-interval busy/sample counts, used for High Disk %

QAPMJOBL.JBPAGF.reason: Column exists with the correct name/type/description ("PAG faults") but was empirically always 0 across every sampled job/interval on host clark75, library KTB, 2026-08-06. Do not use for per-job page-fault ranking — use QAPMJOBL.JBTFLT instead, which has real data. Re-verify on a different host/library before trusting this field there.
